plate.comment:
BeginPlay loader for replay, arcade, tutorial, SEM, and spectator HUD widget classes.

Algorithm:
1. Resolve UUserWidget::StaticClass for each widget load.
2. Load seven hard-coded UMG widget blueprint classes by path.
3. Store class pointers into ALuxHUD_Partial fields at +0x390..+0x3C0.
4. Tail-call AActor::BeginPlay dispatch after class pointers are cached.

Parameters:
  pHud: ALuxHUD_Partial * - HUD actor with the widget-class cache modeled through +0x3C0.

Returns:
  void.

Structure Layout:
  Offset | Size | Field | Type | Description
  +0x390 | 8 | pReplayIconWidgetClass | void* | /Game/HUD/Replay/Widgets/RP_ReplayIcon
  +0x398 | 8 | pReplayDamageInfoWidgetClass | void* | /Game/HUD/Replay/Widgets/RP_DamageInfo
  +0x3A0 | 8 | pArcadeInfoWidgetClass | void* | /Game/HUD/Arcade/Widgets/ArcadeInfo
  +0x3A8 | 8 | pTutorialExplanationWidgetClass | void* | /Game/HUD/Tutorial/Widgets/TutorialExplanation
  +0x3B0 | 8 | pSemBattleInfoWidgetClass | void* | /Game/HUD/SEM/Widgets/SemBtlInfo
  +0x3B8 | 8 | pSemDamageIconWidgetClass | void* | /Game/HUD/SEM/Widgets/SemDamageIcon
  +0x3C0 | 8 | pSpectatorIconWidgetClass | void* | /Game/HUD/Network/Widgets/PmSpectaterIcon

Special Cases:
  - This is a UI class loader, not a replay simulation tick or input history producer.
